en: Search or wander: Enter a word such as 晚安, its English label, or a source name. With an empty search, the search button opens the suggested random word.
Read the whole card: The Chinese word, English label, creative interpretation, English paraphrase and source credit are separate fields. Read them together.
Browse, save or share: Use arrows to continue, H to favorite, E to export or S to share. Esc closes the card. Share uses your browser’s share sheet when supported, otherwise a copied link.
zh: 搜索，或随意逛逛: 输入“晚安”、英文词名，或出处名。搜索框为空时，点击搜索按钮会打开当前随机推荐词。
把整张卡片读完: 中文词名、英文词名、创作重释、英文转述与出处是不同字段，适合放在一起理解。
浏览、收藏、分享: 方向键继续，H 收藏，E 导出，S 分享，Esc 关闭卡片。支持时会打开浏览器分享面板，否则复制词条链接。

caption.en: A quiet home screen with a record, search and keyboard hints.
caption.zh: 首页的唱片、搜索与键盘提示。

caption.en: Searching 晚安 finds the bundled Good night entry.
caption.zh: 搜索“晚安”，找到内置的 Good night 词条。

caption.en: The opened card keeps its interpretation and source together.
caption.zh: 打开卡片，重释与出处一起保留。

caption.zh: 按向右方向键，切换到下一个内置词条“礼物”。

art_note.zh: 当前蓝色词典的真实卡片，保留创作重释与出处。
